friendly.dialogue.chat/1: There you are! I was JUST telling the kettle we were due a proper talk, %1$s. Come in, come in.
friendly.dialogue.chat/2: A chat? You've made my whole afternoon. Sit — how are you, really?
friendly.dialogue.chat/3: Always time for you! What's on your heart today?
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.attentive/2: Hm? What can I do for you, love?
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Give me just a moment, would you?
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.busy/2: One moment, love — hands are full.
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Sorry, love — didn't quite follow. Try again?
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.confused/2: Hm, say that once more for me?
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/2: Safe travels, love. Come by again.
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: Hello there, %1$s! Lovely to see you.
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: Oh, %1$s, dear! Come by any time, you know that.
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.hail/3: Good to see you, love. How's the road treating you?
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: You could ask about %2$s, if you like.
friendly.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Alright, %1$s. I'll leave you in peace.
You already asked, you sweet thing! Still fine, still glad you care enough to check twice.
Twice in a day? You spoil me, %1$s. Same answer, twice the smile.
More. Right. I've been trying to think of a reason to keep you here, %1$s, and you've handed me one.
You want more. Then sit down properly, because I've a great deal of it.
More, then. That's the best thing anybody's said to me this week.
...Oh. I'd been about to tell you the rest of it, %1$s.
...That's a colder answer than I expected from you. I'll leave it there.
...Right. Well. I'll not go on about it, then.
...Not that. I'd been enjoying this and you know I had.
That's the one thing I'd have asked you not to say just now.
...Oh, don't, %1$s. Not while it was going well.
So good, honestly! The oven's been kind, the neighbors kinder, and now you're here. Full week!
Really good, and better for your face at the door, %1$s. You brighten a room.
Lovely week, lovelier now. No complaints — and I'd share them if I had any!
Then you understand the day properly, %1$s. Most visitors don't.
Good. Come and stand with us — you'll be somebody's cousin by the end of the evening.
Right. You'll do. I'd hoped you'd say that, if I'm honest.
...I know it's common, %1$s. I told you because it was mine.
That's what you'd say to a stranger. I'd thought we were past that.
...Everyone. Right. I'd hoped for the smaller answer.
Nothing I could name, %1$s. That's the trouble — a named thing you can put down.
I don't know. I'd tell you if I did; that's rather why I'm still standing here.
Nothing in particular. It helps that somebody asked, though.
One of them, maybe. It's the roof, %1$s. It's been the roof since spring.
The roof. I've not said that out loud to anybody, so — there it is.
It's the roof. Thank you for staying long enough for me to get to it.
Nothing you could put on a list, %1$s. It's the weight of the ordinary.
No one thing. That's why I've not mentioned it — there's nothing to point at.
The ordinary. It helps to be asked, even when there's no answer to give.
It's the hours, mostly. And nobody noticing them until now, %1$s.
The hours. I'd not have said so if you hadn't sat down for it.
It's the hours — and the fact that you asked twice. That's the part I'll remember.
The wood, then! Tuesday. Come early and I'll feed you first, that's the deal.
You're asking after me. After the other week. That means more than you probably intended, %1$s.
You came back. Right. I'll answer, and I'd rather do this than not.
After the other week, and you've still asked. Alright. Sit down.
A heavy stretch, truth be told. But you asking? That warms me like fresh bread, %1$s.
A bit heavy, if I'm honest. Come sit — talking with you already helps.
It began badly, improved without permission, and here we are, %1$s.
I'll tell it properly if you sit down. It's a better story than either of us behaved in it.
It started as nothing and I'd rather it hadn't stayed nothing, and it hasn't.
...But you asked me, %1$s. I thought you wanted to know.
You asked. I'd have kept it to myself otherwise, honestly.
...I only said it because it was you who asked.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.day.good: ...Oh. I'd wanted to tell you about it, %1$s.
That's not what I'd hoped you'd say to that one.
...Right. I'll not share the next good hour, then.
Lovely day! Traded eggs for honey at the well, and everyone had a minute to chat. My favorite kind.
Grand! Waved to half the village and every one waved back. That's a good day, that.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.day.roug: ...I know everyone does, %1$s. I told you because it was mine today.
That's the answer for somebody you don't know. I'd hoped for the other one.
...Right. I'll ask about your day instead, then.
It is, a bit. It's kind of you to just let it be hard without trying to mend it.
A stumbly one — burnt the porridge, tripped over the cat. Nothing warm supper and good company won't mend!
Not my easiest, but a friendly face mends most things. Perfect timing, %1$s.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.day.youn: ...Fine. I thought you'd want to hear it, %1$s.
Right. Forget it. I'd been saving it for you, mind.
...I'll not bother you with the next one.
That's a story for old friends by a low fire, %1$s. We're getting there. Keep coming around, I mean it.
Ask me when you've a key to my kitchen. We're close — not quite THAT close yet.
Ah, that's kitchen-table talk, and we're still at the front gate! Come by more — the kettle's always on.
I'll tell you anything once we're proper friends — and we're nearly there!
friendly.dialogue.conversations.dreams.c: Then we're two fools with plans, %1$s, and that's a much better number than one.
You've given me yours. I'll not forget that, and I'll ask you about it later.
Two of us. I'd not expected that, and I'm very glad of it.
Two fools with plans and nothing owed, %1$s. That's a rarer thing than it sounds.
No obligations. Which means whatever comes of this comes freely, and I prefer that.
Two of us and no debt in it. I'd like that to keep being true.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.dreams.f: A table long enough for the whole village. Everybody fed, nobody hurrying. You'd have a seat, of course.
A house where nobody ever eats alone. That's the whole dream, %1$s.
I want to stand where the land runs out, and I'd want to tell somebody about it after.
That's better than a promise you'd break, %1$s. Thank you for the honesty.
You told me the truth instead of the nice thing. I'll remember which you chose.
Honest. And you stayed to say it, which is the part that mattered.
...I told you that because it was you, %1$s.
That's the one thing I'd not have expected you to laugh at.
...Right. I'll not tell you the rest of it.
...You mean that, %1$s? Then it's the first time it's been more than mine.
You'd help. I'd not ask for that and I'd not turn it down either.
Then there are two of us. I'll not pretend that doesn't change something.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.dreams.r: ...I know, %1$s. I'd hoped you'd ask about it before you measured it.
That's the cold half. I'd been telling you the other half.
...Right. I'll bring you the finished version next time.
You never told me it would work, %1$s. You came back to ask anyway. That's the part I'll keep.
You were honest and then you were here. I'd take that over encouragement any day.
Coming back after saying it might not work — that took something.
You said you'd help, %1$s. I waited a bit, then got on with it alone.
You offered and then life happened. I know how that goes. I still noticed.
You're here now. I'd rather say that than pretend I hadn't been waiting.
A little. Slowly. But you asking is more than most do, %1$s.
Some. And the asking helps, which I'd not have predicted.
A bit. Ask me again in a month and I might have more to tell you.
You said you'd help, and you came back to ask, %1$s. That counts for a great deal.
You did both. I'd have been glad of either and you brought both.
You turned up. That's the rarer half of a promise and you did it without being reminded.
The first step. Nobody breaks it down like that, %1$s. Alright — here it is.
One step, you say. Sit down, then, because I'd like to say it out loud to somebody.
You've made it a thing I could start. That's more use than encouragement has ever been.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.dreams.y: ...Everyone says that. I'd hoped you wouldn't, %1$s.
That's what the grown-ups say. I thought you were different.
...Right. I'll tell somebody who'd like the idea.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.family.c: ...Mine aren't, %1$s. Mine are entirely their own people.
That's not how it goes with them. I'd have told you if you'd asked.
...I'd rather you met them before you decided that.
That's useful, %1$s. Actually useful, not the usual advice.
Right. Something I can do. Come back and I'll tell you whether it worked.
That I can use. Thank you for treating it as a real question.
They ARE, %1$s. Don't tell them I agreed with you.
Right. You're not wrong, and I'd only say so to you.
They are exactly that. I love them and they are exactly that.
...That's not what they need, %1$s. I'd have hoped you'd see that.
Firmer isn't the answer with mine. I'd tell you why if you'd ask.
...I know you mean it kindly. It's still the wrong advice.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.family.m: You've one I don't know, %1$s? Go on — I'll not interrupt. Much.
Right. Yours, then. Sit down properly; I'd like the whole of it.
One I've not heard. Those are worth more than anything I could tell you.
There's one I always come back to. Sit down, %1$s — this one's for people I like.
One story. I've been waiting for somebody to ask, if I'm honest.
There's one. Sit with me and I'll give you the whole of it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.family.p: ...You want to know what I worry about, %1$s? Nobody's asked me that.
That question doesn't get asked of parents. Sit down. I'll try to answer it properly.
What I worry about. Give me a moment — I'd like to get this one right.
...I'll stop asking, %1$s. I only wanted to know how they were.
Right. I'll not raise them again unless you do.
...That's fine. It was your family, not mine to open.
...You're welcome, %1$s. It's the only useful thing I do.
Right. It needs doing and I'm glad it's noticed, which it usually isn't.
Thank you. Say it to them sometime as well — they'd not expect it either.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.family.r: Honest, at least, %1$s. Anyone else would have pretended and I'd have known.
You forgot. I'd rather that than a performance. Ask me again and I'll tell you again.
Everyone forgets. You came back, which is the part that actually counts.
Next time, %1$s. People say that. You'd be the first who did it twice.
Right. Ask me. I'd like to be asked, and I'd not have said so a year ago.
Do. And I'll have something to tell you, which is a good reason to have something.
Better than I expected and worse than I'd hoped, %1$s. That's most of family.
It went. Sit down and I'll tell you the parts that surprised me.
Nothing's fixed. But nobody's stopped talking, and you asking is part of why.
...That is better, %1$s. I hadn't known I was allowed to want that one.
Right. No plan. Sit with me and I'll say it in whatever order it comes.
Listening. Thank you. Everyone else arrives with a plan and none of them fit.
...You did, %1$s. People say they will. You're the first who came back about it.
You remembered. That matters more than the thing itself did, and I'd not know how to say why.
You came back. I'd like you to know that I noticed, and that I'd counted the days.
...Actually help, %1$s. Nobody says actually. They say 'anything at all' and mean nothing.
Come by on a Thursday. That's it. Bring nothing; just be in the room.
Ask me again in front of them. You've no idea what that would do.
...Glad. Right, %1$s. I'd braced for the other thing.
So am I. And I'd not have said so an hour ago, which is your doing.
Then it was worth saying. Thank you for making it worth saying.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.ch: Don't, %1$s. I gave you that; I didn't hand you a challenge to win.
That's not what I was asking for, and I think you know it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.co: Don't, %1$s. I didn't tell you so you'd make it smaller.
That's kindly meant and it lands wrong. I'd rather you just sat there.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.fi: Honestly? An empty chair at supper. Folks drifting off one by one till it's just me and the kettle.
That someone here is hurting and I didn't notice. I'd never forgive myself.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.fo: Slowly. But slowly is a direction, %1$s, which is more than I had before you asked.
Some. And you asking is part of why there's any at all.
It's moving. I'd not have told anyone else that.
...It isn't nothing, is it, %1$s. I keep telling myself it's nothing.
You'd call that something. Coming from you, I might believe it.
Right. It counts. I needed somebody else to say so before it could.
You did say that, %1$s. It's been a while since, mind.
You said it and then you were gone a while. I'm not holding it against you.
Right. I'd started filling the gap myself, which is what one does.
There wasn't a promise, %1$s. You've just kept turning up.
You never said you would. You just did, and that's worth more than the saying.
No promise. Only the turning up, every time, without being asked.
You did say that, %1$s. And you turned up, which is the rarer half of a promise.
You said it and you meant it. I'd have forgiven you for only meaning it at the time.
Both halves. I'd like you to know that I noticed both.
You didn't promise anything, %1$s. I remember. That's why I believed the rest.
You stepped back rather than say a thing you weren't sure of. I noticed that.
Right. And it's the reason I've told you more since than I've told anybody.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.op: ...Nobody offered the 'with you' part before, %1$s. That's the part that changes it.
With you. I could do it with you. I could not do it alone and I've proved that twice.
Easy for you, %1$s. You've somewhere else to be when it goes wrong.
I know you mean it kindly. It still comes from somebody who can leave.
Maybe I could, %1$s. Not today, but maybe.
Possibly. I'd want you there, if it came to it, and I've not said that before.
Perhaps. Ask me again some other week and we'll see what I say.
Don't, %1$s. I gave you that; I didn't hand you a challenge to win.
That's not what I was asking for, and I think you know it.
Maybe. With a witness, maybe. Don't let me back out of it later, %1$s.
With you there, yes. That's the only version of this I could actually say yes to.
...You mean that, %1$s. You're not just being polite. Then here's the part I don't say.
That landed as true. Alright. I'll trust it and give you the rest.
It is, %1$s. Not much to be done about it, though.
Hard, yes. I'm glad you said so, even if saying so doesn't shift it.
That's... yes. It is hard to carry, %1$s. Thank you for saying so.
Right. Hard. I'd not have said it first and I'm glad you did.
Yes. And you stayed to say it, which is most of why it helped.
Don't, %1$s. I didn't tell you so you'd make it smaller.
That's kindly meant and it lands wrong. I'd rather you just sat there.
...That helps, %1$s. I've no idea why saying it aloud to someone helps, but it does.
Better. And it's specifically better for having said it to you.
You'll stand with me. That's — thank you. I'll not forget you said it, whatever comes.
...You don't flinch, do you, %1$s. Alright. The rest of it, then.
You stayed. That's what buys the rest, and nobody else has bought it.
Some of it, maybe. Not tonight, %1$s. Tonight's too much like the night it happened.
A little. Ask me again in daylight and you might get further.
There's more to it, %1$s. Whether you get it is another question.
More, yes. I'd like to tell you and I'm not there yet.
There's a rest. Ask me another week and it might be different.
I've told you more than I've told anyone, %1$s. Let that be enough tonight.
That's as far as I go, even with you. Especially with you, maybe.
There's more, yes. Give me a breath, %1$s. ...There. Two of us carrying it now.
More. Sit closer, then. I'd rather not say this across a room.
You too? Huh. It's less heavy when two people carry it, %1$s.
You as well. Then tell me yours — I'd rather this went both ways.
Two of us. I'd not have guessed, and I'm glad you said.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.pl: Honestly? I don't know, %1$s. That's a worse answer than I expected to give you.
No idea. Ask me again once I've thought — I'd like to have a proper answer for you.
I don't know. Nobody's asked, so it's never had to become a question.
You remember all of it, don't you, %1$s. Even the part I nearly didn't say.
The whole of it. Nobody keeps the whole of it. I'd not expected to be kept.
All of it. That's the part that makes this easier than last time.
...No plan. Just this. That's better than a plan, %1$s.
No fixing. Then sit down and I'll say it in whatever order it comes.
Just listening. That's what I'd have asked for if I'd known I could.
Do something about it. You make it sound like a chore list, %1$s. ...Maybe it is.
A plan. From you I'll hear it out, which I'd not do from most people.
Fix it. Alright. Say the first step and I'll tell you honestly whether I could.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.pr: I've told you more than I've told anyone, %1$s. Let that be enough tonight.
That's as far as I go, even with you. Especially with you, maybe.
No. You were told, and you asked again. Get away from me, %1$s.
I said no. From anybody else I'd have expected it. Not from you.
That's twice. Go, before I say the thing I'd not be able to take back.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.fears.yo: ...I told you because I thought you'd understand, %1$s.
That's what people say when they'd rather not be in the room.
...Right. I'll take it to somebody else, then.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.feelings: Oh, you're family already, %1$s — didn't you know? The door's never locked for you.
The day's always brighter with you in it. I've thought so a good while now.
And that's plenty, %1$s. Honestly, that's plenty.
Plenty. I'd rather have the true amount from you than a larger one from anyone.
That's enough. And you said it to my face, which is the part that counts.
...A real one. That's a word people use loosely, %1$s. Not you, I think.
Friend. I'd hoped so and I'd not have been the one to say it first.
You said it out loud. That's the whole difference between thinking it and having it.
...I wasn't, %1$s. I'd have said if I were.
That's not it at all, and I'd hate you to go away thinking it was.
...Right. Let's put that down and start again.
Changed? No, %1$s. If anything it's settled into something steadier.
The same, and thank you for coming back to check rather than assuming.
No change. Ask me every few months, though. I'd like to be asked.
...You meant it, %1$s. People say things once and hope you forget.
Twice. I'd not have asked you to say it again and I'm glad you did.
Said again, unprompted. That's the part I'll be thinking about tonight.
...Right. Forget I said it, %1$s. I'd rather keep what we have.
That's fair. I'd sooner have you as you are than have said nothing right.
...I'll not raise it again. We're all right, you and I.
...Plainly. After all this time you say it plainly, %1$s. I love you too.
I love you. I'd been saying it in every other way for a year and hoping you'd hear it.
You said it first. I'd have got there. Slower, but I'd have got there.
...Slower. Alright, %1$s. I'd rather have you at your pace than not at all.
Your pace. Tell me when it changes, or tell me when it doesn't. Either is fine.
Slower. I'll not raise it. You know where I stand, and standing still is allowed.
...Fine. I only said it because it was true, %1$s.
Right. Forget it. I'd not have said it to just anyone, mind.
...I'll not say it again. But I meant it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.firstmet: Now I'd not want a version of this village without you in it, %1$s. Plainly said.
Now I know you're quiet because you're listening. I've been careful with my words since.
Now I've stopped forming an opinion and started being glad. That took me a year.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.food.fir: Anything shared! A meal's better with company. Bring your appetite, I'll bring the butter.
The inn's stew, at a full table. Food tastes better among laughing folk, don't you think?
The baker's rye. Half of why it's good is who I usually eat it with.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.food.pre: Beetroot. It stains everything and tastes of soil, and the cook keeps trying, bless her.
Beetroot. Don't tell the cook. She's convinced she'll convert me one day.
Beetroot — though if you made it, I'd probably eat it and say nothing.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.food.rec: Do, and tell me honestly whether it worked, %1$s. I'll take the criticism.
Try it. And come and tell me either way — I'll want to hear about it.
Do. Then come back and we'll fix whatever went wrong together.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.food.rev: I tried the mushroom thing, %1$s. I was wrong about mushrooms and you should hear me say it.
I tried it because you asked me to. That's the only reason, and I'm glad of it.
The mushrooms. You were right. Tell me the next thing I'm wrong about.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.food.tra: Bread hates me. Actual bread, %1$s, in a village that's half bakery. Don't be embarrassed for me.
No bread. If you're ever cooking for me, that's the whole of what you need to know.
I have to watch the sweets. One cookie, the cleric says. Don't stop offering, though.
Sweets are counted. If you're baking, I'll want one and I'll want you to let me decide.
Keep the milk away from me. I learned that in front of the whole market, and they still tease me.
No milk. If you're cooking, ask me first — I'd rather that than be polite about it afterwards.
...It's not an excuse, %1$s. I'd eat it if I could, gladly.
That's a hard thing to hear from you, of all people.
...I'll not make a thing of it. But it isn't an excuse.
Now you ask, %1$s. Alright. It's arithmetic, every meal, forever — and asking helps.
You asked properly. That's rarer than you'd think, and I'll tell you the whole of it.
Now. Right. Sit down and I'll explain it once, and then you'll know.
The sirben feast on the night wind, %1$s. We do not speak of the recipe, but I like that you asked.
No meat for me. The butcher glares across the square and brings me his best vegetables anyway.
No meat. Ask before you cook and I'll eat anything else you put in front of me, gladly.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.food.you: It IS proper food, %1$s. My gran made it and I'd not hear a word against it.
You'd like it if somebody made it for you properly. I'd make it for you.
...Right. I'll not argue. But come and eat some before you decide.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.future.h: After the harvest, %1$s, if it's kind. Before it, if I lose my nerve.
Sooner than I've said out loud. I've been rounding it up so you'd not feel hurried.
I've not let myself pick a season. You picking one with me would settle it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.gossip.a: We've a new neighbor — %2$s just moved in! I brought them bread and a warm welcome. Do go say hello.
%2$s joined our little village! I've already got them coming for supper. Everyone deserves a friendly start.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.gossip.b: The best news! Little %2$s was born, safe and sound. I've knitted the tiniest blanket you ever saw.
%2$s came into the world this week! A new little one to love. The whole village is over the moon.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.gossip.d: Oh, %1$s... we lost %2$s. Such a kind soul. I've a casserole ready for the family. It's the least I can do.
%2$s passed on. The whole village feels it. Come sit a while — grief's lighter with company.
%2$s moved away for good, bless them. I'll miss their face at the well. I made sure they left with a full basket.
Sad to see %2$s go — packed up and off somewhere new. I'll write, of course. You don't just lose a neighbor.
Sad to say, %2$s and %3$s have parted ways. I've had them both round for tea. I just want them each to be alright.
%2$s and %3$s split up, poor dears. No sides to take — I care for the both of them just the same.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.gossip.m: Oh, wonderful news — %2$s and %3$s got married! I cried at the vows, %1$s. Happy tears, all of them.
%2$s and %3$s wed this week! Two lovely souls, one happy home. My heart's just full.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.gossip.n: Quiet week! Everyone's fine, fed, and boring — which is the best news a village can have, honestly.
Not a peep! Come back tomorrow — someone always does something worth telling.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.happy.gr: You weren't meant to, %1$s. I'm telling you because not telling you got heavy.
It does. I've a habit of keeping the good things quiet and I'm trying to stop.
Now you do. I'd rather you knew it from me than worked it out on your own.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.happy.un: Then: I'd like more of the ordinary hours with you. Not the grand ones. The dull ones.
I want to be asked, not managed. You do it kindly, %1$s, and it's still managing.
...I'm frightened you'll go and be happier. There it is, and I still love you, and both are true.
...There is, %1$s. I've been happy and lonely in the same house and I can't explain it.
One thing. You're away more than you were, and I keep telling myself it doesn't matter.
Yes. Four times I've decided to say it to you, and four times I've lost my nerve.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.hopes.cl: Go on, then, %1$s. It's easier to hope at something when there's two of you doing it.
You'd trade yours for mine. I'll not forget that, and I'll ask you about yours next week.
Two of us. That's what I'd been missing and I hadn't known to say so.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.hopes.fo: ...I've never got that far, %1$s. Break it down, you say. Alright: first the money.
The first step. Sit down — I'd like to work it out with somebody rather than at somebody.
One step. You've made it a thing I could start, which nobody else has managed.
Do you, %1$s? Then we're both waiting on something. Good company.
You as well. Tell me about yours — I'd rather this went both ways.
Two of us. I'll ask about yours next time, and I mean that.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.hopes.re: You waited for me to find the words. That's a real kindness and I don't think you know it.
It's small, %1$s. That's why I told you and not the square.
I'd hoped you'd be the one who didn't laugh at that one.
...Right. I'll keep the small ones to myself from now on.
Still, yes. I'd thought you'd remember, %1$s — you asked me first.
It's the same one. I've not had a new one since I told you.
...Right. I'll not bring it up unless you do.
...You'd actually help, %1$s. That changes it from a hope to a job of work.
You'd help. Then let's find the first bit and I'll not do it alone this time.
Right. With somebody else in it, it's a different thing entirely.
You remembered the shape of it, %1$s. Not just that there was one. Yes. Still.
You had the details. That's the part that tells me you were listening and not waiting.
Right. You remembered which one, and that matters more than the answer does.
Still, %1$s. It hasn't moved, but neither have I stopped.
Yes. Same one. Thank you for coming back to ask about it.
Still hoping. And you asking is most of why it's still worth hoping at.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.hopes.yo: It's not silly, %1$s. It's mine, and I told you first.
I thought you of all people would like it.
...Right. I'll tell somebody who'd want to hear it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.life.clo: You didn't have to do that, %1$s. Trading is better than being asked, though. Much better.
You gave me one back. That's the kindest thing anyone's done in this conversation.
Trading beats asking. I'll remember that you knew that without being told.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.life.fir: Nobody's asked in ages! Get comfortable — it's a long one, with three good harvests and a lot of shared suppers in it.
A warm sort of story, full of neighbors and open doors. I remember every one fondly.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.life.fol: Did it, %1$s? Then you'll know why I've never made much of it.
You as well. Tell me yours properly some evening — I'd like to hear it.
Same, then. That's a strange comfort and I'll take it.
...Alright, %1$s. You want the next part. Right, then. Here it is.
The next part. Sit properly — this one takes a while and I'd rather not rush it.
You want more. Nobody wants more. I'll give you the whole of it, then.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.life.res: ...I was fourteen, %1$s. I told you that so you'd know me, not judge him.
That's the hardest thing you could have said to that story.
...Right. I'll stop telling you the old ones.
There's more to it, aye. Where were we, %1$s?
More, yes. You'll have to remind me — I'd rather pick up where you left off.
There's a rest. Sit down and I'll find my place.
You remembered which part, %1$s. Alright. Here's how it ended.
You had the right chapter. That tells me you were listening and not waiting your turn.
You knew where I stopped. Sit down, then — the ending is the part worth having.
Where it leaves me. Huh. Better than it left me then, %1$s.
Now? Better. And being asked about now rather than then is part of why.
It sits differently. Nobody asks that, and it's the question I'd want asked.
It was, and you asked, %1$s. I'd not have started it otherwise.
Right. I'll stop. You can ask me again another evening if you like.
...I'd rather have told you badly than not at all, mind.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.life.rev: You asked about my life once and it stayed with me all week. Here's the rest, if you want it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.life.you: That's what grown-ups say when they'd rather not answer.
...Right. I'll ask somebody who'll take it seriously.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.neighbou: We did. There was a winter we didn't, and I've missed them the whole time since.
Well enough. We fall out about the fence and we'd still sit up with one another.
No, %1$s. They wronged me. I'd rather you knew that from me than found it out.
There's more to them than the one story, %1$s, and you're the sort who'd want it.
Ask me. I'd rather you had it from me than from someone who doesn't like them.
Go on. I'll tell you what's mine to tell — and I'd not offer that to everyone.
Then you'll be the first, %1$s, and they'll pretend they didn't need you to.
Go in the morning. They're proudest after dark, and pride makes a poor host.
Good. Don't announce it. Put it by the door and let them keep their dignity.
I will, %1$s. Coming from me it gets past the pride, which is the trick of it.
That's the wiser way round, and I'd not have thought of it if you hadn't asked.
Consider it said. Don't expect thanks. Expect a nod in six months and be glad of it.
Better than the week before, %1$s. That's the most anyone can say about anyone.
Proud and cold, in that order. The cold will pass and the proud won't.
Asking that puts you ahead of everyone who asked about the firewood, and I noticed.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.fol: Me? I'm — thank you. I'm alright. And you? You get to answer that too, %1$s.
I'm well, and it's kind of you to ask. Now tell me about you, properly.
Better for being asked. And you? Don't make me ask twice.
...It isn't ours to hand round, %1$s. It's theirs.
I told you because I trust you with it. That's the whole of why.
...Please don't. They'd know it came from me.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.gla: Do, %1$s. This is the one kind of news that improves in the telling.
Pass it on. Tell the ones who've had a hard month first — they need it most.
Do. And come back and tell me who was most pleased about it.
...Must you, %1$s. I was so pleased to be telling somebody.
That's not what I'd hoped to hear back from you.
...Right. I'll take the good bit and leave the rest with you.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.gra: ...Firewood, and nobody to fetch it, %1$s. That's the honest answer.
Somebody to sit with them who isn't crying. You'd manage that, and few would.
Nothing they'd ask for. Everything they'd take, if it were offered quietly.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.mix: So do I, %1$s. It's a strange thing, watching people go.
Kind of you. Half the village is placing bets instead, and you're not.
True enough. Whatever it is, I hope it works out for them.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.res: Standing, %1$s. Which at three weeks is the whole of what you can ask for.
Worse than last week and better than the week before. It goes in waves.
They asked after you. I told them you'd been asking after them, and they were glad.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.sad: ...Get away from me. I'd not have believed that of you.
No. Not from you, %1$s. Not about this.
...Go. Please. Before I say something I'd have to take back.
Not well. Nobody is. Thank you for asking after them and not the details, %1$s.
Badly. Sit a moment. It's easier to say with somebody in the room.
Not well. You asked about them, not about what happened, and I noticed that.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.tee: ...Too young. From you, %1$s. That's the part I hadn't expected.
Everyone in the square repeats it. I told you because I thought you'd hear it differently.
Fine. I'll not bring you the next one, and I'd rather that weren't how this went.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.news.you: It's not repeating if it's true, %1$s. And you asked me.
I'd not have said it to anyone else. Only to you.
...Right. I'll say nothing next time, even to you.
Not this, %1$s. Of all the people to say that, I'd not have guessed you.
Then go and be even-handed at somebody who hasn't just trusted you.
I was braced for that from strangers. Not from you.
Long enough to have stopped counting. You're the first to ask, %1$s.
Since the frost. I nearly told you twice and lost my nerve both times.
A while. I kept meaning to say it to you and never found the right afternoon.
Not the ending. The part where I'm still here and you don't recognise me.
That I'll do something I'd never do — to you, most likely, since you're nearest.
Being handled gently. Don't you start, %1$s. You're the last one who talks to me straight.
Frightened, %1$s. There's something in me that wasn't there last month.
I've been better. You're the first person I've said that to without softening it.
Don't ask me kindly, or I'll tell you the whole of it and I'll not be able to stop.
Still, yes. I'd thought you might ask what actually happened, %1$s.
Right. I'll not bore you with it again.
...It's not nothing, mind. But I'll drop it.
...I'll get carried away if I like, %1$s. I'd wanted you carried away with me.
That's a cold thing to do to somebody who was that pleased.
...Right. I'll be pleased about it on my own.
The quiet bit at the end of the day, when I remember it's still true. Telling you is close second.
The end of the day — and this, now, saying it to somebody who asked.
Remembering at dusk that it hasn't gone. And you asking about it, which nobody did.
They do. From you, though — I'd expected better, and that's the part that stings.
Every one of them remembers who said that to them. I'll remember it was you.
Then I'll manage alone, which is not what I wanted from this conversation.
Frightened and pleased at once, %1$s. I've told nobody the frightened half.
Well enough. Better than my mother had it, and I think of her more than I did.
Some mornings I can't lace my boots. You may laugh — I did.
No, %1$s, and I'd only admit that to you. Everyone else gets a brave face.
Ready as a house half-built. Come and see it when it's finished, whatever it is.
I was ready in spring. Ask me again next week and you'll get a third answer.
Tired in a way I don't mind, %1$s, which is new for me.
Large, mostly. You may say so. Everyone else has been carefully not saying so.
Two of us in here now. It still surprises me every morning.
Since about the spring, if I'm honest, %1$s. It crept.
Spring. I've not said that to anybody, so you're the first to have the date.
About six months. Saying it out loud to you is the first time I've counted it.
...No. I'm not, %1$s. Nobody's just said it, so I've been getting away with 'fine' for weeks.
No. And I'd rather you than anybody else be the one who noticed.
No, I'm not. Sit down, then, since you've gone and asked properly.
Mostly. There's a thing, but it's small and it'll keep, %1$s.
Mostly fine. There is something — ask me again when we've more time.
Mostly. I'd tell you the rest if you sat down, but you've somewhere to be.
You look like it, if you don't mind me saying, %1$s. Sit down a minute.
You do. And I'd rather say it than let you carry it about all afternoon.
You look it. Come and sit — I'll not ask anything, I'll just be here.
...Get away from me. I'd have taken that from anyone but you.
Go, %1$s. Please. Before this becomes the thing I remember about you.
...No. Not now. Come back when you've thought about it.
Ah. You heard, then. We lost one of our own. The whole village feels the gap. Thank you for asking, %1$s.
You heard. Sit with me a moment. It's better than standing about with it.
We lost somebody. I'm glad it's you who came and asked, and I'd not have said that a month ago.
Right. Has the rain reached your side of the village yet, %1$s?
Very well. What do you make of the new gate? I want an honest answer, mind.
Easier, then. Where were you before here? I've wondered and never asked.
Nothing that's yours yet, %1$s. It might be, in time. Not today.
That's twice. I'd like to keep liking you, so let's stop here.
No. I gave you the polite version because I wanted to. Don't make me regret it.
From you? That stings worse than the wound, %1$s.
It's my scratch. I'd have taken anything else from you but that.
Right. I told you because it was you. I'll not make that error twice.
Then I'll still be here, %1$s, and I'll be less pleasant about it. Come anyway.
You'd best. I'll not send for anyone myself, and you're the only one who'd notice.
That's the useful sort of kindness. Everyone offers sympathy; you came back.
Something came out of the dark faster than I did. I'd not tell that to everyone.
My own fault, %1$s, and I'd rather hear you say so than have you be polite.
A fall, and a stupid one. You may laugh. Everyone else has managed to.
Been better, %1$s. I took a bad one two nights back and I've not shaken it.
Sore. I'd not have said so to anyone else stood there, mind.
In myself I'm fine. It's the rest of me — and I'm glad it's you asking.
It wasn't nothing to me, %1$s. That's the part I'd wanted you to hear.
Then I'll keep the next one to myself, and you'll never know there was one.
Fine. I'd been saving that up for a fortnight, but fine.
I have been getting on with it. From you I'd hoped for a different sentence.
Right. The last four got 'fine'. I gave you the true one and this is what it bought.
Then I'll be tired somewhere else. I'd rather have stayed here, but there it is.
A whole day, %1$s. I'd not know what to do with one, but I'll find out.
You mean that, don't you. Nobody's offered, and I'd stopped expecting anyone would.
Then I'll take it, and I'll not spend it usefully, and that's the point of it.
Since the spring. You're the first to ask, and I'd counted on nobody asking.
Long enough that I've stopped calling it a bad patch and started calling it me.
I couldn't tell you, %1$s. There wasn't a day it started.
Tired, %1$s. Not the kind sleep fixes, so don't offer me an early night.
Worn through. I'd not have said that to the last three people who asked.
I've been better. You'll be wanting a reason and I haven't got one.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.people.e: Exhausting. They cross the lane when they see me coming, %1$s. You didn't.
It wears. You're the first to ask what it's like rather than what I did.
Tiring. And you've stood here for a whole conversation, which is more than most.
Don't, %1$s. I told you about it; I didn't ask you to fix it.
That's kindly meant and it's too fast. There's more to it than I've said.
...I could, %1$s. Hearing somebody else say it makes it smaller than it was.
Talking. It's the obvious thing and the hardest one, and you knew that when you said it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.people.f: I adore them, every one. Even the prickly ones have a soft middle, with patience and cake.
The best neighbors in the world. We look after each other — that's the whole point of a village.
...No, %1$s. I've been avoiding it for a season and you've noticed.
Talking. There's a thought. Everyone here prefers a grudge, myself included.
You make it sound simple. Coming from you it might even be.
No, %1$s. I like them, and I've already gone further than I should.
That's as much as I'll say. They'd not thank me for the rest.
...I'd rather you heard the rest from them.
The baker, and I'll deny it if it gets back to the miller, %1$s.
The baker. She kept me fed one bad winter and never mentioned it once.
The baker. Ask me again in a year and it'll still be the baker.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.people.g: Then here it is, %1$s. The miller's brother has been counting my firewood.
Right. The miller's brother. And this stays between us, because he's not a bad man.
Since you'll keep it: my woodpile has a very attentive admirer, and he's family to the miller.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.people.r: You want the specifics. Alright, %1$s — but this stays here.
Specifics, then. I'm telling you because I trust you with it, and that's not nothing.
Right. One example. And you'll understand why I've not said it before.
...You've lived here five minutes, %1$s. I've lived here with them.
There's more to them than you've seen. I'd tell you, if you'd ask instead.
...Right. I'll not defend them at you. You'll see it yourself in time.
Less than I'd planned, %1$s. The planned version was a speech and speeches don't mend.
That I'd been unfair. Two words were true and the rest was scaffolding.
Nothing clever. 'I've been avoiding you.' It did more than a year of thinking had.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.people.s: They're a lot. Kind, but a lot. I like them best from my window, waving — and you're easier than most.
Kind and loud. I do like them; I'd simply prefer them one at a time.
A lot, and I mean that fondly. Come round when it's just you and I'll be much better company.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.people.y: ...That's a horrible thing to say, %1$s. They've been kind to me.
Don't. I like them, and now I have to decide what to do about liking you.
...Right. I'll pretend I didn't hear it. Once.
You didn't owe me that, %1$s. It does help. More than the forgiving would have.
You gave me one back. That's the kindest possible way to have answered me.
That helps. And I'll ask you about yours another day, if you'll let me.
...You don't, %1$s. Nobody's said that. I'm not sure I believe it, but I'll keep it.
Right. From you it's harder to dismiss, which is inconvenient of you.
Nobody has said that out loud. I'd not known I was waiting to hear it.
...That's better, %1$s. Absolution I'd not have trusted. This I do.
Right. You stayed and said nothing useful, and that was the useful thing.
Sitting with it. Thank you. That's what I'd have asked for if I'd known how.
...You don't get to decide that, %1$s. And yet something just came loose.
It isn't yours to give. Coming from you it went in anyway, and I'll not fight it.
Kind, %1$s. It doesn't reach the part of me that decides these things, but it helps a little.
That's kindly meant and I'd rather have it than not. It just doesn't go all the way in.
Don't, %1$s. I know you mean it, and it isn't yours to give.
That's the kindest wrong thing anyone's said to me about it.
...You don't, %1$s. Hm. I'll keep it and see whether it holds by morning.
Right. I'll take it, and I'll tell you tomorrow whether it stayed.
...That's not what I offered, %1$s. I'd have said if it were.
I trusted you with the outline. The rest isn't ready to be handled.
...Right. Ask me again in a year and it might be different.
It has, a little, %1$s. You told me I wasn't a bad person and it stuck.
Some. What you said stayed with me, and I'd like you to know that it did.
A little. It's mostly the one sentence, and it was yours.
A little, %1$s. You didn't tell me it was fine, and that's why I believed the rest.
Some. You listened. I've thought about that evening more than the thing itself.
A little. And it's because of how you took it, not what you said.
A little, %1$s. Time does some of it. Being asked after does the rest.
Some. And you asking is genuinely part of it, which I'd not have expected.
A little. Ask me again some time — apparently that's how it moves.
I have, since you asked last, %1$s. Thinking's most of the way there.
I've thought about it. Your asking is why. I'd not have got there on my own.
Since you asked, yes. Ask me once more and I might have done something.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.rumors.d: ...You're right, %1$s, and I've been telling it all week without asking myself that.
I'll hold it, then. If it's true it will reach me from somebody else.
That's the sensible line, and it's the one nobody here draws. I'll try to.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.rumors.m: Ask me properly, %1$s. You'll get a straighter answer than I gave the last person.
There's what's said and there's what I think. You can have the second one.
Go on. I'd rather be questioned by you than quoted by somebody else.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.rumors.p: ...Them, %1$s. Not the story. I've told four people this week and you're the first.
Badly, and privately, and they'd not want it discussed. Thank you for asking anyway.
That's the right question. I'll tell them somebody asked it — that will matter to them.
No, %1$s. It's a death in somebody's family, not a story for the square.
That's exactly why I didn't say. I'd tell you most things. Not this one.
I said as much as I'm willing to. Don't make me say it twice to you of all people.
Good. That's the whole of what I wanted out of telling you, %1$s.
Then I was right about you. I'd been eighty per cent sure and I'm glad of the twenty.
Thank you. I'll know by Thursday whether that was true, and I've no doubt it will be.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.season.t: They're NOT. Come and look with me, %1$s.
They are! I wanted to show you and now you've said that.
...Fine. But you'd like them if you looked.
I'd have shown you what's different, if you'd wanted it.
...Right. I'll not go on about the season, then.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.secret.c: You'd trade. Right. Now we've each a rope round the other's ankle, %1$s, and that's how it should be.
A trade. You didn't have to and I'll not forget that you did.
Yours for mine. That's not a burden you owed me and it's the reason I can breathe.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.secret.f: ...That's all it was, to you, %1$s. I'd carried it for four years.
I gave you that because it was you. That's what makes this sting.
...Right. I'll not go further than that with anyone again.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.secret.r: ...Alright, %1$s. The 'famous' pie I bring to every festival? The trader sells them.
Right. Here it is. I'm telling you because it's you and for no other reason.
Fine. You've got it. Sit down, there's a bit more to the story.
Because you've never repeated a thing I've said, %1$s. I've been counting.
Because you don't carry things to the square. I've watched, and I'd not have told you otherwise.
You've never once passed anything on. That's why it's you and not anybody else.
...You asked after me, %1$s. Not the secret. You always were the right person.
Me first, again. I'd like you to know I noticed both times.
Still the right person. That's the whole of why this has been easy to carry since.
...You asked after me, %1$s. Not the secret. Nobody does that.
Me, not it. That's the whole reason I told you in the first place, and here's the proof.
You asked about me first. I'd hoped you would and I'd not have blamed you if you hadn't.
You wouldn't promise, %1$s, and you've kept it anyway. That says more.
No promise, and no leak. I'd rather that than a vow from anybody else.
You refused to swear to it. That's why I believed the rest of you.
You gave your word and you've kept it, %1$s. I checked, in my way. Thank you.
Word given, word kept. I'd not have held it against you and I'm glad I don't have to.
You said you would and you did. That's most of what I mean when I say I trust you.
It's still between us, then, %1$s. Good.
Still ours. I'd not doubted it and I'm glad to have it said out loud.
Nothing has moved. Thank you. That's more of a gift than it sounds.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.standing: A lecture, was it. I'd thought you wanted to know, %1$s.
Right. I'll keep it to a sentence next time.
...I only said it because it mattered to me that you knew.
A lecture, was it. I'd thought you wanted to know, %1$s.
Right. I'll keep it to a sentence next time.
...I only said it because it mattered to me that you knew.
That's why I gave you both, %1$s. A comfortable answer would have cost you a year.
Then you'll get the truth from me every time. Not everybody wants that from me.
Good. The ones who only want the warm half never mend anything, %1$s.
That's the work, %1$s, and it's slow. Years, not weeks, and no thanks along the way.
Then start with the ones who won't look at you. I'll tell you who they are.
It can be done. I've watched it twice, and I'd like to watch it a third time.
The forgiving one, %1$s. I got there late and I'm sorry it took me that long.
Neither yet. I'd rather choose you properly than choose you quickly.
Yours. I'd have thought that was plain by now.
You ask questions nobody else asks, %1$s. I've not decided if that's good yet.
You're new and you've been kinder than new people usually are. I'm watching to see if it lasts.
Undecided, and I mean that hopefully rather than otherwise.
You want it honest, %1$s? There's a matter people haven't let go of. It sits between you and this village.
Honestly — something's still being talked about, and I'd rather you heard it from me.
There's a matter. I'm telling you because I'd want telling, and nobody else will.
Steady, %1$s. You turn up, and turning up is most of it.
Hard to read and easy to like. I got to the liking quickly, if you want the truth.
You listen longer than you talk. I noticed it the first week and I still notice it.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.us.first: ...You did, %1$s. Not anything you said. Just that you stayed.
You stayed when it stopped being easy. I've thought about that afternoon since.
It wasn't a thing you said. It was that you were still there when I looked up.
...You don't remember it, %1$s. I've thought about that day rather a lot.
Right. Well. It mattered more to me than to you, then. That's all right.
...I'll not bring it up again. It's a nice memory to keep on my own.
You want the story of how we met, %1$s? Go on, then. I'll tell it my way.
The story. Sit with me. It's a better one than either of us behaved in it.
Right. I'll tell it, and then you tell me yours, and we'll see how different they are.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.us.futur: ...Work it out. Aye. That's better than one of us just giving in, %1$s.
Both of us, then. I'd rather spend a year on it than have you concede in an evening.
Neither surrenders. That's the version I could live with for a long time.
That's fair, %1$s. I'd rather that than a promise you'd resent.
Right. Nothing owed. I'd sooner have you here freely than here on a debt.
No promise. Thank you for not making one you weren't sure of.
...Never. That's a hard word from you, %1$s, of all people.
Right. I'd rather know than wonder. It still lands like a stone.
...I'll not ask again. We can still be what we are, I hope.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.us.happy: ...You want to know, %1$s. Right. Small things — and you asking is one of them.
You asked. Nobody asks when things are fine. Sit down; it's a short and easy list.
Right. There's a list, and every item on it is smaller than you'd fear.
...I asked you a serious question, %1$s. I'd been working up to it.
Right. I'll take that as a no and not press it.
...It mattered to me that I asked. That part still counts.
We will, %1$s. I believe you when you say it.
Right. Then we will. I'd not have believed that from anybody else, mind.
I believe you. Come here. That's the end of the conversation and the best part of it.
Happy? You're the best thing that ever walked through my door. Every single day, yes.
The luckiest soul in the village, and it's your fault entirely. Yes, love. Yes.
friendly.dialogue.conversations.us.resum: ...Honestly. Right, %1$s. That's worth more than a better answer would have been.
So have I. There — now neither of us has to perform, which is a relief.
Drifted. Yes. Thank you for saying it first; I'd been working up to it.
...In a month. Yes, %1$s. Put it somewhere you'll actually look.
Ask me. I'd rather be asked than left to raise it myself again, and you know I would.
A month. Right. I'd like that. I'd like it more than I'd have admitted a year ago.
Further than I'd have said out loud a month ago, %1$s.
Not far. But it hasn't gone backwards, and having you ask is part of why.
I think about it most evenings. That's where it's got to, and I'd only tell you.
...You still do, %1$s. Right. I'd been holding my breath about that for a fortnight.
Then we're both still standing where we said we'd stand. That's rarer than it sounds.
I hoped you'd say that. Thank you for saying it before I had to ask.

...One selfish thing, %1$s. I'd not thought of it that way and it changes the arithmetic.
Earned. Say that again in front of the mayor and see what it costs me.
Three times. The one who thanked me came back specially, and I've thought about that ever since.
A year of ploughs. I'd still be at the same anvil; you'd not notice the difference from the lane.

Weaponsmith. Work the bellows for me some afternoon — steady and slow, and I'll talk your ear off.

Every time. Ask me about the tavern bar and I'll tell you about the tree and the afternoon it came down.

friendly.dialogue.conversations/1: I was hoping you'd stop by! Pull up a chair, %1$s — there's bread if you want it. What's on your mind?
friendly.dialogue.conversations/2: Of course we can talk — I could go all day! Where shall we start?
friendly.dialogue.conversations/3: You never have to ask twice with me. Sit, sit!
